question: What public reset-start config shape should OpenClaw support for customizing prompt text and startup-turn behavior after `/new` or `/reset`?
rationale: The request adds a compatibility-sensitive config surface across session state, reset command handling, bootstrap prompts, and adjacent greeting/model policy, so automation should not invent the permanent contract.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy covering prompt text, ack-only versus startup-turn behavior, bootstrap safeguards, and future greeting/model controls.

options.title: Narrow To Prompt Text Only
options.body: Add only a prompt-text override while preserving current acknowledgement defaults and documenting exactly when the text is used.

options.title: Defer New Config
options.body: Keep the hardcoded prompt and resolve the broader reset greeting policy before adding another config key.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy covering prompt text, ack-only versus startup-turn behavior, bootstrap safeguards, and future greeting/model controls.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans reset command behavior, user-visible acknowledgement semantics, and config compatibility around recent reset-command work.
